people.name: Sodom
people.line: Wicked city destroyed by God for its sins

translations.web: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”
translations.bsb: So the LORD replied, “If I find fifty righteous ones within the city of Sodom, on their account I will spare the whole place.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place
translations.asv: And Jehovah said, If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sake.
